calc_hf_prob: calculate the Hartree-Fock probability density for electron positions given an SCF approximation and spin counts
make_effective_batch_network: create a batch network function that computes half the log of Hartree-Fock probability for MCMC sampling
make_rprime_mcmc_step: build an MCMC step function for sampling r-prime electron positions using Hartree-Fock probability
get_rho: compute a sample of the one-body density matrix from electron positions and Hartree-Fock molecular orbitals
eval_mos: evaluate molecular orbitals at given electron positions for restricted or unrestricted Hartree-Fock calculations
